# VVCM third-party source

This directory vendors the forward-kinematics portion of
[MorningFrog/VVCM](https://github.com/MorningFrog/VVCM) at commit
`9beca1c9803ba3e6d17d3c088bc0c6809138dd76`.

Vendored files:

- `include/VVCM_FK.hpp`
- `src/VVCM_FK.cpp`
- `LICENSE`

The vendored source is unmodified and remains licensed under Apache-2.0.
The ROS 2 integration code outside this directory is not part of the upstream
VVCM project.
